pages:
FIRST INFORMATION REPORT (Under Section 173 BNSS)
District: Navgarh    Police Station: Station Road    FIR No.: 208/2026
Date and time of FIR: 02-05-2026 at 09:30 hrs
Act and Sections: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 - Sections 106(1), 281
Occurrence: 02-05-2026 at about 07:10 hrs
Place of occurrence: Station Road, near the MSRTC bus stop, Navgarh.
Informant: Nitin Patil, S/o Harish Patil, aged 35, R/o 22 Gandhi Nagar, Navgarh.

Contents of information:
I, Nitin Patil, state that my father Harish Patil, aged 61, goes for a morning walk daily.
On 02-05-2026 at about 7:20 am I received a phone call from a neighbour that my father had
met with an accident on Station Road. When I reached the spot, the people there told me that
a white SUV driven by a lady at high speed hit my father while he was crossing the road. My
father was taken to the District Hospital, Navgarh, where he was declared dead.
The vehicle is a white Hyundai Creta, registration no. NV-01-CK-4521.
Legal action may be taken against the driver.

Action taken: Case registered and investigation entrusted to ASI Sunil Gaikwad.

02_Statement_Anil_Deshmukh_PW1.pdf.title: Statement of eyewitness Anil Deshmukh under Section 180 BNSS
pages:
STATEMENT UNDER SECTION 180 BNSS
FIR No. 208/2026, P.S. Station Road, Navgarh
Name: Anil Deshmukh, aged 58, retired clerk, morning walker.
Recorded by: ASI Sunil Gaikwad on 02-05-2026.

On 02-05-2026 at about 7:10 am I was walking on Station Road. I was about 10 steps away from
Harish Patil. He was crossing slowly at the zebra crossing, from the divider side towards
the
footpath. A silver-grey car came at very high speed, about 80 km per hour, and hit him on
his
left side. The car was driven by a woman with long hair. Nobody else was in the car.
The woman got down after the accident. I know Harish Patil from the walking group.

Read over and found correct.

03_Statement_Lata_Pawar_PW2_scanned.pdf.title: Statement of eyewitness Lata Pawar under Section 180 BNSS (scanned copy)
pages:
STATEMENT UNDER SECTION 180 BNSS
FIR No. 208/2026, P.S. Station Road, Navgarh
Name: Smt. Lata Pawar, aged 45, vegetable vendor at the MSRTC bus stop.
Recorded by: ASI Sunil Gaikwad on 03-05-2026.

I sell vegetables near the bus stop. On 02-05-2026 at about 7 am a bus was parked at the bus
stop. The old man suddenly came onto the road from behind the parked bus. A white car hit
him.
The car was not very fast. A man was driving and a lady was sitting next to him.
After the accident the man got out and went away towards the railway station. The lady
stayed
and was phoning someone.

Read over and found correct.

04_Statement_HC_Rahul_More_PW3.pdf.title: Statement of Head Constable Rahul More (first responder)
pages:
STATEMENT UNDER SECTION 180 BNSS
FIR No. 208/2026, P.S. Station Road, Navgarh
Name: Head Constable Rahul More No. 233, traffic duty.
Recorded by: ASI Sunil Gaikwad on 02-05-2026.

On 02-05-2026 at about 7:25 am I reached the spot on information from control room.
The injured had already been taken in the 108 ambulance. A white Hyundai Creta NV-01-CK-4521
was standing on the road. The lady Kavita Rao was present near the car. No male driver was
present at the spot. Skid marks of 4.2 metres were seen behind the car. The speed of the car
appears to have been high. I informed the police station.

Read over and found correct.

05_Post_Mortem_Report.pdf.title: Post-mortem report
pages:
POST-MORTEM REPORT
District Hospital, Navgarh.   PM No. 118/2026
Name of deceased: Harish Patil, male, aged 61.
Date and time of post-mortem: 02-05-2026 at 14:00 hrs.

External injuries:
1. Lacerated wound 6 x 2 cm over right parietal region of scalp.
2. Abrasion 10 x 4 cm over right hip and right thigh.
3. Deformity of right thigh; fracture of right femur on dissection.
4. Abrasions over both palms.
No injuries on the left side of the body.

Internal: Fracture of right parietal bone with subdural haemorrhage.
Cause of death: Head injury, consistent with a road traffic accident.
Opinion: Injuries on the right side indicate primary impact on the right side of the body.
Dr. Prakash Kulkarni, Medical Officer.

06_Mechanical_Inspection_Report.pdf.title: Motor vehicle inspection report
pages:
MOTOR VEHICLE INSPECTION REPORT
Office of the Regional Transport Officer, Navgarh.
Vehicle: Hyundai Creta, registration no. NV-01-CK-4521, colour: Pearl White.
Date of inspection: 03-05-2026.

Brakes: working properly. Steering: working properly. Tyres: in good condition.
Damage: front left bumper broken, left headlight broken, dent on the left side of the
bonnet.
No damage on the right side of the vehicle.
Skid marks measured at site by IO: 4.2 metres. Skid marks of 4.2 m length indicate a speed
of
approximately 25 to 30 km per hour at the time of braking.
Opinion: The accident was not due to any mechanical defect.
Motor Vehicle Inspector, RTO Navgarh.

10_Client_Interview_Notes.txt.title: Defence counsel's client interview notes
pages:
Client interview - Kavita Rao - 06-05-2026 (privileged, defence counsel notes)

Driver: Kavita says her employed driver Manoj Shinde (employed since 2024) was driving. She
was in the front passenger seat. After the accident Manoj panicked and ran away towards the
railway station. She stayed, called 108 at about 7:12 am and waited for the police.
Police recorded her as the driver because she was the only one at the car.

Accident: The old man came suddenly from behind the parked MSRTC bus. Manoj braked at once.
Speed was low because they had just left the petrol pump.

CCTV: She told ASI Gaikwad on 02-05-2026 to collect the CCTV of Bharat Petrol Pump at the
corner, which faces the road. No CCTV appears in the police papers.

Manoj Shinde: phone switched off since 02-05-2026. Salary records and his licence copy are
with Kavita.

To do: application for preservation of petrol pump CCTV; summon Manoj's salary register;
cross-examine PW1 on his distance from the spot and the zebra crossing.
